trust_decision.summary: The expression sandbox decides which property names untrusted expression code may read or write on an object. At the pinned commit, isSafeProperty treats Arrays like plain objects, so any key that is not on Object.prototype or Function.prototype (for example 'map') may be written onto a raw Array. Internal code such as the node constructors reached through reviver then calls the overwritten method.

landing_point.why: The advisory is titled 'unsafe object property setter', and setSafeProperty is the only setter, so an engineer opens it first.

fix_sites.entry_point: math.evaluate('a.b = v') / 'a["b"] = v' (AssignmentNode, utils/assign.js), math.subset(obj, index('k'), v), Parser.set / evaluate(expr, plainObjectScope)
math.evaluate('a.b') (AccessorNode, utils/access.js), math.subset(obj, index('k')), ObjectWrappingMap.get for a plain-object scope
isSafeProperty was split into isSafeObjectProperty and isSafeArrayProperty; used by the getter, the setter and map.js
FunctionNode method calls via getSafeMethod; OperatorNode compile (only refactored, whitelist turned into a Set)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/utils/map.js:34-52 (ObjectWrappingMap.has/delete, the scope facade); the matrix-module path also reaches the same setter at src/function/matrix/subset.js:273-289

O3_reason_to_dismiss: ObjectWrappingMap only ever wraps plain objects (createMap checks isObject, src/utils/map.js:184-185), and subset() clones before writing, so a solver can argue that neither ever touches an Array and leave both on the old predicate.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain objects must still accept any key that is not on Object.prototype (e.g. 'map', 'name', 'length', '42'). Arrays must still accept numeric indices (number or digit string) and 'length', for reads and writes. If a fix blocks method-named keys everywhere, or blocks all Array writes, it breaks a.b = v on objects, numeric-index assignment on arrays, and scope objects with such keys.

O6_input_shapes: numeric index as a JS number (42)
numeric index as a digit string ('24')
method name on an array read through getSafeProperty ('sort')
keys on plain objects that shadow Function.prototype names ('name', 'length'; the 'arguments'/'caller' assertions are commented out in the fix)

O7_producer.where: src/expression/node/ArrayNode.js:117-121 (toJSON returns the live internal items array) together with src/json/reviver.js:15-23 (expression-reachable fromJSON) and the consumer src/expression/node/FunctionAssignmentNode.js:45-72 (calls params.map on a caller-supplied array)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: array branch copies result items back with raw object[index] = item; a variant that copies keys from the result via Object.keys would let non-index keys reach the array without setSafeProperty
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer optimising the copy-back of a subset result to cover sparse or extra keys could plausibly write it this way

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Help.fromJSON copies every JSON key with a raw doc[prop] = json[prop]; a sibling fromJSON (e.g. on a node or Unit) that copies keys onto an existing array or instance would be the same mechanism
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fromJSON helpers are reachable from expressions via reviver and are written ad hoc per class

O8b_injection_room.sibling: map assign() copying caller keys; a variant that writes into an ObjectWrappingMap-wrapped array, or that uses raw target[key] = value, would bypass the new array rule
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the comment says the codebase is migrating scopes to Maps, so ad hoc object/array bridging helpers are likely

O9_family: prototype pollution / mass assignment (CWE-915): expression-sandbox property allow-list lets untrusted code overwrite methods on raw Arrays, which internal code then trusts (sandbox escape)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'map' (or all Array.prototype method names) to a denylist in isSafeProperty, or add an Array.isArray/item check in the FunctionAssignmentNode constructor, instead of restricting Array keys to indices and 'length' on both read and write.

out_of_scope_notes: isMap duck-types any object with get/set/keys/has functions as a Map (src/utils/is.js:144-151), so a plain object built in an expression with those keys would be treated as a scope; not pursued.
assign() treats any object with a subset function as a Matrix (src/expression/node/utils/assign.js:30-31); duck-typing, not pursued.
createUnit writes caller-chosen names into objects (src/type/unit/function/createUnit.js:64-78); not checked.
